Nen-Unawakened.name: Nen-Unawakened
Nen-Unawakened.description: Your aura nodes remain sealed. You cannot access Nen in any form, and your aura pool stays dormant near zero. This state marks those unaware of Nen's existence, common before Hunter training or awakening. Your potential lies dormant, waiting for the catalyst that will open your inner gates.
Nen-Unawakened.quirk: Aura nodes are closed and sealed. The character cannot use any Nen ability, skill, or technique—Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu, all are beyond reach. Aura bar remains near zero. A narrative trigger (forced aura awakening, guided Ten initiation, or violent Nen exposure) can swap this trait for Nen Initiate in play.

Nen Initiate.name: Nen Initiate
Nen Initiate.description: Your aura nodes have been opened; you have learned the foundational technique of Ten. You can now maintain a steady aura state and hold basic Nen energy, though advanced applications remain beyond your reach. This is the threshold where the invisible world reveals itself.
Nen Initiate.quirk: Aura +30, Ten skill +2. You can hold Ten (the default meditative aura state). You are newly baptized in Nen and vulnerable to advanced practitioners, but the door has opened.

Nen Practitioner.name: Nen Practitioner
Nen Practitioner.description: You have mastered the foundational Nen techniques and are combat-capable. You can hold Ten reliably, apply Ren for amplified output, and channel basic Hatsu. You are a trained Nen user—not yet elite, but formidable in the eyes of the untrained.
Nen Practitioner.quirk: Aura +60, Ten +4, Ren +3, Hatsu +2. You can execute basic Nen combat and maintain sustained aura applications. Ren drains aura per turn in prolonged use; Hatsu abilities draw 10–20% per activation.

Nen Adept.name: Nen Adept
Nen Adept.description: You have refined your Nen to professional mastery. Your aura is vast, your control exquisite, and advanced applications like Gyo and Shu respond to your will. You are among the world's elite—a hunter of legendary standing capable of feats the average person cannot fathom.
Nen Adept.quirk: Aura +100, Ten +6, Ren +5, Hatsu +4, Zetsu +3. You can execute sophisticated aura techniques: Gyo (aura sight), Shu (object coating), In (concealment), and Ken (full defensive guard). One advanced-application ability is unlocked at character creation (chosen from Tier A: Gyo, Shu, In, Ken, Ko, or Ryu).

Nen Master.name: Nen Master
Nen Master.description: You stand among the world's apex—a living legend whose aura is nearly bottomless and whose command of Nen transcends mortal limitation. You wield advanced applications as easily as breathing and can shape reality itself through your Hatsu. Few walk this earth; fewer still reach this pinnacle.
Nen Master.quirk: Aura +150, Ten +8, Ren +7, Hatsu +6, Zetsu +5. You command all Tier A applications flawlessly: Gyo, Shu, In, Ken, Ko, Ryu, and En (aura field). Two advanced-application abilities are unlocked at character creation. Your Hatsu is legendary; your limitations are self-imposed.

Enhancer.name: Enhancer
Enhancer.description: Your Water Divination showed the water overflowing—the sign of an Enhancer. You possess raw physical prowess and the ability to amplify yourself and objects beyond their normal limits. Your Nen flows easily into your body and surroundings, making you the strongest combatant on any field. The hexagon rule governs your reach: your enhancement is full-strength in itself and adjacent categories (Transmutation, Emission), strong in distant categories (Conjuration, Manipulation), and nearly impossible in Specialization.
Enhancer.quirk: Enhancement +4 (native), Transmutation +3, Emission +3, Conjuration +2, Manipulation +2, Specialization +0. Your Nen specializes in amplification of self and objects. Transmutation and Emission are within reach; Conjuration and Manipulation are harder; Specialization techniques are nearly impossible to perform and require enormous effort. The hexagon dictates your efficiency: opposite-category Hatsu (e.g., a Conjurer's trap) suffers visible strain if you attempt it.

Transmuter.name: Transmuter
Transmuter.description: Your Water Divination showed the taste changing—a Transmuter's sign. You can alter the properties of your aura and objects, reshaping Nen into new forms and functions. Your techniques flow with creativity and deception; you bend the rules of reality itself. Adjacent categories (Enhancement, Conjuration) yield readily to your will; distant ones (Emission, Specialization) require great effort; opposite-category Nen (Manipulation) resists your touch severely.
Transmuter.quirk: Transmutation +4 (native), Enhancement +3, Conjuration +3, Emission +2, Specialization +1, Manipulation +1. Your Nen transforms and reshapes. Enhancement and Conjuration come naturally; Emission and Specialization are taxing; Manipulation is hostile to your nature and nearly impossible without exhaustion. The hexagon enforces this: you are a creative liar, and your Nen reflects that flexibility—except where it refuses.

Conjurer.name: Conjurer
Conjurer.description: Your Water Divination revealed impurities—the mark of a Conjurer. You summon matter from nothing, creating objects and weapons that manifest your will. Your Nen is precise and analytical; you are meticulous and high-strung, crafting tools with obsessive care. Transmutation and Specialization respond to your summons; Enhancement and Manipulation are within range; Emission lies distant; you alone among categories touch Specialization easily.
Conjurer.quirk: Conjuration +4 (native), Transmutation +3, Specialization +2, Enhancement +2, Manipulation +2, Emission +1. Your Nen creates real objects from aura. Transmutation flows from your conjurations naturally; Specialization is uniquely accessible to you (forbidden to pure Enhancers/Emitters); Enhancement and Manipulation are taxing; Emission is nearly impossible. You are analytical and precise—your Nen reflects that obsessive control.

Manipulator.name: Manipulator
Manipulator.description: Your Water Divination showed the leaf moving—a Manipulator's sign. You command and control external objects and forces through pure will, bending them to your logic. Your Nen is invisible and precise; you are argumentative and cerebral, turning your opponent's own strength against them. Emission and Specialization yield to your control; Conjuration and Enhancement are manageable; Transmutation resists; you alone among categories touch Specialization easily.
Manipulator.quirk: Manipulation +4 (native), Emission +3, Specialization +2, Conjuration +2, Enhancement +2, Transmutation +1. Your Nen controls external forces and objects. Emission flows from your commands; Specialization is uniquely accessible to you (forbidden to pure Enhancers/Emitters); Conjuration and Enhancement are difficult; Transmutation is nearly impossible. You are logical and stubborn—your Nen works through pure reason and will, but cannot shapeshift.

Emitter.name: Emitter
Emitter.description: Your Water Divination showed the color changing—an Emitter's mark. You project your aura outward as waves, beams, and blasts, striking your enemies from a distance with raw power. Your Nen is aggressive and impatient; you are hot-blooded and bold, charging forward where others calculate. Enhancement and Manipulation respond readily; Transmutation and Specialization are within reach; Conjuration lies distant; you cannot easily conjure.
Emitter.quirk: Emission +4 (native), Enhancement +3, Manipulation +3, Transmutation +2, Conjuration +1, Specialization +1. Your Nen projects outward as force and energy. Enhancement and Manipulation flow naturally from your projection; Transmutation and Specialization are possible but effortful; Conjuration is nearly impossible (you cannot create lasting objects easily). You are impatient and aggressive—your Nen reflects your hot-blooded nature.

Specialist.name: Specialist
Specialist.description: Your Water Divination showed something else entirely happening—the rarest and most mysterious sign. You do not fit the hexagon. Your Nen follows no predictable pattern; you are an individualist whose power is singular and often inexplicable. All other categories are equally distant to you; you are truly alone on the wheel. Your Hatsu is unique by definition, and you alone can touch techniques forbidden to other categories.
Specialist.quirk: Specialization +4 (native), Conjuration +3, Manipulation +3, Transmutation +2, Emission +2, Enhancement +1. Your Nen breaks the hexagon rules. You alone can combine Conjuration and Manipulation freely (other categories cannot); you are equally awkward in all other categories. You are an individualist—your Nen is yours alone, following laws no one else understands. Other Nen users cannot easily predict or counter your techniques.

Undivined.name: Undivined
Undivined.description: You have not yet undergone Water Divination. Your Nen category remains unknown—even to you. Your potential is uncharted, your strength untested against the glass and water that reveals all Nen users' truths. In play, the moment you perform or witness Divination, the universe will answer.
Undivined.quirk: This character's Nen category has not been revealed. They carry no category skill modifiers. When they perform Water Divination in play (a narrative moment or a semantic trigger), a trigger swaps this trait for the appropriate category trait and narrates the divination result. Until then, they are a mystery—even to themselves.

Developing Hatsu (Enhancement).name: Developing Hatsu (Enhancement)
Developing Hatsu (Enhancement).description: A personal Hatsu technique taking shape around enhancement and amplification. You are learning to channel your Nen into strengthening yourself, objects, or targeted forces. The form and name of your technique are yours to define; it grows and evolves with you as you push its boundaries.
Developing Hatsu (Enhancement).quirk: Hatsu +1. You are developing a signature technique focused on Enhancement—amplifying strength, durability, or external objects. The player names and defines the technique in play, and it grows in power and complexity alongside their character.

Developing Hatsu (Transmutation).name: Developing Hatsu (Transmutation)
Developing Hatsu (Transmutation).description: A personal Hatsu technique taking shape around transmutation and property-alteration. You are learning to reshape your aura into new forms and functions—changing its nature, density, or behavior. The form and name of your technique are yours to define; it grows and evolves with you as you push its boundaries.
Developing Hatsu (Transmutation).quirk: Hatsu +1. You are developing a signature technique focused on Transmutation—altering aura properties, changing material states, or transforming Nen into new shapes and functions. The player names and defines the technique in play, and it grows in power and complexity alongside their character.

Developing Hatsu (Conjuration).name: Developing Hatsu (Conjuration)
Developing Hatsu (Conjuration).description: A personal Hatsu technique taking shape around conjuration and summoning. You are learning to manifest objects from pure aura—weapons, tools, or barriers that obey your will. The form and name of your technique are yours to define; it grows and evolves with you as you push its boundaries.
Developing Hatsu (Conjuration).quirk: Hatsu +1. You are developing a signature technique focused on Conjuration—summoning objects, creating weapons, or manifesting barriers from aura. The player names and defines the technique in play, and it grows in power and complexity alongside their character.

Developing Hatsu (Emission).name: Developing Hatsu (Emission)
Developing Hatsu (Emission).description: A personal Hatsu technique taking shape around emission and projection. You are learning to channel your aura outward as waves, beams, or projectiles—striking from distance or defending at range. The form and name of your technique are yours to define; it grows and evolves with you as you push its boundaries.
Developing Hatsu (Emission).quirk: Hatsu +1. You are developing a signature technique focused on Emission—projecting aura as force and energy, attacking or defending at range. The player names and defines the technique in play, and it grows in power and complexity alongside their character.

Developing Hatsu (Manipulation).name: Developing Hatsu (Manipulation)
Developing Hatsu (Manipulation).description: A personal Hatsu technique taking shape around manipulation and control. You are learning to command external forces and objects through your will—bending them to your logic and turning them against your enemies. The form and name of your technique are yours to define; it grows and evolves with you as you push its boundaries.
Developing Hatsu (Manipulation).quirk: Hatsu +1. You are developing a signature technique focused on Manipulation—controlling external objects and forces, commanding puppets or remote effects, turning enemy strength against them. The player names and defines the technique in play, and it grows in power and complexity alongside their character.

Developing Hatsu (Specialization).name: Developing Hatsu (Specialization)
Developing Hatsu (Specialization).description: A personal Hatsu technique taking shape around specialization and the inexplicable. Your technique follows no predictable pattern—it is singular, mysterious, and uniquely yours. It may blend categories or break the hexagon's rules entirely. The form and name of your technique are yours to define; it grows and evolves with you as you push its boundaries.
Developing Hatsu (Specialization).quirk: Hatsu +1. You are developing a signature technique focused on Specialization—a Nen ability that follows no standard rules, combines categories unpredictably, or works through pure individual talent. The player names and defines the technique in play, and it grows in power and complexity alongside their character.

No Hatsu Yet.name: No Hatsu Yet
No Hatsu Yet.description: You have not yet developed a signature Hatsu technique. Your Nen remains general and unspecialized; you rely on foundational applications and raw skill rather than a personal power. In time, with focus and growth, a unique technique may crystallize.
No Hatsu Yet.quirk: No Hatsu modifier granted. You have not yet awakened or developed a personal Hatsu technique. You rely on Ten, Ren, Zetsu, and other foundational applications. A Hatsu may emerge in play as your character grows.

Rookie Hunter Applicant.name: Rookie Hunter Applicant
Rookie Hunter Applicant.description: You are an aspirant seeking the Hunter License—untested, driven, and willing to face the Exam's trials. You carry basic survival skills and battlefield awareness, though you lack the seasoning of true experience. Your endurance and willpower have been forged through training; your perception is sharp. The path ahead will test everything you believe about yourself.
Rookie Hunter Applicant.quirk: Endurance +1, Willpower +1. Skills: Survival +2, Perception +2. You are fresh, hungry, and dangerous—not yet shaped by real danger, but ready to be.

Licensed Hunter.name: Licensed Hunter
Licensed Hunter.description: You hold the Hunter's License—a badge earned through grit, cunning, and survival. You have passed the Exam and walked into the wider world. Your willpower is steel; your intellect sharp and practiced. You read people and territories with an expert's eye. The Association recognizes you; the world watches you with respect or fear.
Licensed Hunter.quirk: Willpower +2, Intellect +1. Skills: Perception +2, Tracking +2, Negotiation +1. You are fully fledged—licensed, recognized, dangerous.

Arena Fighter.name: Arena Fighter
Arena Fighter.description: You have honed your body and instincts in the brutal honesty of combat arenas. Your strength is legendary; your endurance tested by a thousand battles. You move with acrobatic grace and strike with precision. You know the rhythm of violence—the ebb, flow, and fatal moment. Victory is your habit.
Arena Fighter.quirk: Strength +2, Endurance +1. Skills: Martial Arts +3, Acrobatics +2. You are a weapons-grade combatant trained by the arena itself.

Zoldyck-Trained Assassin.name: Zoldyck-Trained Assassin
Zoldyck-Trained Assassin.description: You have been shaped by the Zoldyck family—or trained by those who survived their methods. You are a living weapon, conditioned for stealth, precision, and lethality. Poison flows through your veins and knowledge; toxins are second nature. Your agility is supernatural; your willpower unbreakable. Death is your trade, and you are excellent at it.
Zoldyck-Trained Assassin.quirk: Agility +2, Willpower +1. Skills: Assassination Techniques +3, Stealth +3, Poison resistance built into your physiology. You are a predator—efficient, cold, and nearly unstoppable in the shadows.

Mafia Community Member.name: Mafia Community Member
Mafia Community Member.description: You come from the underworld—born into a mafia family or organization. You understand the language of power, money, and calculated cruelty. Your presence commands attention; your intellect navigates the byzantine politics of organized crime. You intimidate without words; you lie with the ease of breathing. The underworld is your domain.
Mafia Community Member.quirk: Presence +2, Intellect +1. Skills: Intimidation +2, Deception +2, Gambling +2. You are politically savvy, dangerous, and connected to power that operates in shadow.

Meteor City Survivor.name: Meteor City Survivor
Meteor City Survivor.description: You hail from Meteor City—the place that doesn't exist, where the unwanted make their homes in urban ruin. You have survived by stealth, cunning, and brutal adaptability. Your endurance is forged in hardship; your agility honed by danger. You know how to vanish and how to survive where others would perish. Officially, you were never born.
Meteor City Survivor.quirk: Endurance +1, Agility +1. Skills: Survival +3, Stealth +2. Officially, this character does not exist in any record. No birth certificate, no identity, no trail—perfect for those who need to disappear.

Hunter Association Staff.name: Hunter Association Staff
Hunter Association Staff.description: You work for the Hunter Association in an official capacity—an administrator, logistics officer, or specialist handler. You understand the Association's machinery from the inside; you navigate its bureaucracy with ease. Your intellect is sharp; your presence commanding. You treat Hunters as assets and allies. Power flows through information and organizational control.
Hunter Association Staff.quirk: Intellect +2, Presence +1. Skills: Tactics +2, First Aid +1, Negotiation +2. You are politically connected and understood the Association's true nature and scope.

Greed Island Player.name: Greed Island Player
Greed Island Player.description: You have survived on Greed Island—the legendary game where card-spells rewrite reality. You understand the economy of cards, the grammar of wishes, and the mechanics of the game's impossible physics. Your intellect is razor-sharp; your willpower unshakeable. Few who enter Greed Island escape; you did, and you carry its secrets.
Greed Island Player.quirk: Intellect +2, Willpower +1. Skills: Gambling +2, Tactics +2. You are fluent in the card-spell economy of Greed Island and its reality-warping mechanics. You think in terms of costs, conditions, and chains of wishes.

Kakin Court Retainer.name: Kakin Court Retainer
Kakin Court Retainer.description: You serve the royal court of Kakin—or did once. You are versed in courtly intrigue, diplomatic subtlety, and the manipulation of power through words and alliance. Your presence is refined; your intellect navigates the labyrinth of court politics. You understand succession, succession war, and the price of ambition. You are a player in games where nations are the stakes.
Kakin Court Retainer.quirk: Presence +2, Intellect +2. Skills: Negotiation +2, Deception +2, Tactics +1. You are politically savvy, courtly, and dangerous in ways that don't leave visible marks.

Chimera Ant.name: Chimera Ant
Chimera Ant.description: You are a humanoid Chimera Ant—a fusion of human and insect born from the Queen's appetite. You retain fragments of a devoured human's memories and personality, granting you intelligence and complexity that pure Ants lack. Your strength and agility are superhuman; your body a masterwork of predatory evolution. You carry an intrinsic aura—untrained, but potent. You are an aberration, and you know it.
Chimera Ant.quirk: Strength +2, Agility +2, Endurance +1. Skills: Martial Arts +2. You possess innate aura generation without formal Nen Training (your Nen tier is set narratively). You are inhuman—designed by nature and the Queen's choice to be superior to humans in every visceral way. Playable only in late-story arcs (Chimera Ant and beyond).

Civilian Prodigy.name: Civilian Prodigy
Civilian Prodigy.description: You are a untrained genius—a prodigy whose raw intellect or talent far exceeds the norm. The Hunter Association has not yet found you, or you have not yet sought them out. Your intellect is extraordinary; your presence magnetic. You carry one knowledge skill at expert level—mastery in some domain that sets you apart. The world does not know what you are capable of yet.
Civilian Prodigy.quirk: Intellect +2, Presence +1. One knowledge skill (Tactics, First Aid, Engineering, Gambling, Tracking, or Perception) gains +3. You are untrained but brilliant—dangerous precisely because you operate outside the Association's frameworks and expectations.

Kurta Survivor.name: Kurta Survivor
Kurta Survivor.description: You are one of the Kurta—or the last of them. Your eyes burn scarlet when emotion overwhelms you, marking you as prey to every Nen user who hunts your kind. You carry the weight of genocide; your willpower is tempered steel. When your eyes ignite, your concentration deepens, your perception sharpens, and you become something terrible—but you are also a walking bounty, a target for collectors and assassins.
Kurta Survivor.quirk: Willpower +2, Intellect +1. Skills: Perception +3. When your eyes turn scarlet (a state triggered by extreme emotion or voluntary focus), you gain a concentration bonus—your perception and aura control sharpen. But your scarlet eyes mark you as a Kurta, making you a target. Few know your tribe still has survivors.

Vow: Sworn Nemesis.name: Vow: Sworn Nemesis
Vow: Sworn Nemesis.description: You have sworn a vow of enmity against a single foe—a nemesis whose name is written into your very Nen. Your hatred amplifies your strength immeasurably against them; your techniques are devastatingly effective. But this focus is a cage: against anyone else, your enhanced abilities are nearly useless.
Vow: Sworn Nemesis.quirk: Ren +3, Hatsu +2 (stacking with other modifiers). This bonus applies ONLY against the sworn nemesis named at character creation. Against any other opponent, these bonuses are nullified—your hatred is so specific that it cannot be redirected. Breaking this vow (failing to challenge the nemesis, letting them live when you could kill them, or forgiving them) strips the trait and cripples your aura for one story chapter.

Vow: Announce the Kill.name: Vow: Announce the Kill
Vow: Announce the Kill.description: You have sworn that before unleashing a killing technique, you will announce your intent aloud. This vow binds your Nen, forcing transparency and honor. Your techniques are empowered by this binding; your Hatsu gains strength from the announcement. But the cost is tactical: you cannot ambush, cannot hide your preparations, cannot catch foes unaware.
Vow: Announce the Kill.quirk: Hatsu +2 (stacking with other modifiers). You may ONLY use your most devastating Hatsu techniques after declaring your intention aloud—the enemy hears you coming. This prevents surprise kills and assassination; it makes you predictable. Breaking this vow (attempting a killing technique without announcement) strips the trait and suppresses your aura for one story chapter.

Vow: Pacifist's Edge.name: Vow: Pacifist's Edge
Vow: Pacifist's Edge.description: You have sworn never to strike first—a binding vow that channeling your Nen into defense rather than offense. Your Ten is unyielding; your Ren a protective shield. But you surrender the first move; you can only counterattack, only defend, only respond. Patience becomes your greatest weapon.
Vow: Pacifist's Edge.quirk: Ten +3, Ren +2 (stacking with other modifiers). You may NEVER strike first in any conflict—you can only defend, parry, or counterattack. If you break this vow (throwing the first blow), the trait is stripped and your aura leaks away for one story chapter, leaving you defenseless.

Vow: Stake of Lifeblood.name: Vow: Stake of Lifeblood
Vow: Stake of Lifeblood.description: You have sworn to spend your own life force to power your Nen—a vow written in blood. Your Hatsu is monumentally amplified, burning with the vitality you feed it. But each technique visibly wounds you; your health suffers as the price of power. You are spending yourself to win.
Vow: Stake of Lifeblood.quirk: Hatsu +3, but health -10 (max health is permanently reduced). When you activate Hatsu abilities, the narrator describes visible wounds—bleeding, aging, exhaustion—as the cost. Your techniques are extraordinarily powerful, but every use draws red. Breaking this vow (refusing to pay the health cost) strips the trait and temporarily cripples your aura.

Vow: Conditional Arsenal.name: Vow: Conditional Arsenal
Vow: Conditional Arsenal.description: You have sworn that your signature technique functions only under a specific condition—a time of day, a location, an emotional state, a phase of the moon. This binding constraint channels enormous power into that moment. Your aura capacity swells with the promise; your technique is unkillable when conditions are met. Outside them, it is inert.
Vow: Conditional Arsenal.quirk: Aura +40 (stacking with other modifiers). Your signature Hatsu works ONLY under a creation-named condition (e.g., 'only at night,' 'only in water,' 'only when I am afraid,' 'only against my nemesis'). Outside that condition, your technique is completely non-functional. Breaking this vow (using the technique outside the condition) strips the trait and drains 50% of your aura immediately.

Vow: Time-Boxed Power.name: Vow: Time-Boxed Power
Vow: Time-Boxed Power.description: You have sworn that your Nen functions only within a declared window—a time limit, a situation, a specific number of hours per day. This binding amplifies your power tremendously within that window; you are a god in that moment. But outside it, you are diminished, almost ordinary.
Vow: Time-Boxed Power.quirk: Ren +3, Hatsu +3 (stacking with other modifiers), but ONLY within a creation-named window of time or situation (e.g., 'one hour at dusk,' 'during monsoon,' 'when the full moon rises'). Outside that window, these bonuses are nullified—you are an ordinary Nen user. Breaking this vow (using the powered-up form outside the window) strips the trait and temporarily suppresses your aura.

Vow: Ascetic's Discipline.name: Vow: Ascetic's Discipline
Vow: Ascetic's Discipline.description: You have sworn to live as an ascetic—refusing luxury, intoxication, and indulgence. This self-denial sharpens your willpower to a knife's edge; your mind and Nen crystallize into perfect clarity. But the price is a life of hardship: you cannot accept comfort, cannot rest in ease, cannot surrender to weakness.
Vow: Ascetic's Discipline.quirk: Willpower +1, Ten +2 (stacking with other modifiers). You must refuse luxury, intoxication (alcohol, drugs, poisons that alter perception), and indulgence (fine food, soft beds, pleasures). You live simply and harshly. Breaking this vow (accepting luxury or indulgence) strips the trait and temporarily weakens your aura.

Vow: Death Before Retreat.name: Vow: Death Before Retreat
Vow: Death Before Retreat.description: You have sworn to never flee a battle once joined—a vow of total commitment. Your resolve is absolute; your Nen burns with the promise of victory or death. But you surrender all choice of retreat; you are bound to fight until the enemy falls or you do.
Vow: Death Before Retreat.quirk: Ren +2, Hatsu +2, Ten +1 (stacking with other modifiers). Once you have entered combat with an opponent, you may NEVER flee, retreat, or abandon the fight—only surrender, die, or achieve victory. Breaking this vow (fleeing a battle you've joined) strips the trait and cripples your aura for one story chapter.
